metric_scope: Finite fixed 32-item population; midrank correlations and tie-safe lists; not calibrated probabilities or tail limits
gate_denominator: q90 divided by nominal p, per methods_protocol; B_count/A_actual_count additionally reported
same_budget_rule: Both models use floor(N*p) cutoffs plus complete boundary groups; actual released counts can differ

pair.input_mode: Four fixed 124-pair fresh batches per model/panel/orientation; original oversized 496-pair outputs are never read
pair.oversized_attempts_not_used: Reported separately in the protocol; not scored here
pair.U_rule: Any U fails the full gate. U-affected merged edges enter diagnostic scores as zero with a separate failure count, never as a semantic tie assertion.

gate.meaning: Prespecified finite-sample working gate, not a calibrated statistical test; no U may be hidden by diagnostic tie scores

rank.aggregation: Exact integer 2*midrank sums; Borda numerator=2*m*N-sum, denominator=2*m*(N-1); all exact equalities retained

gate.meaning: Prespecified finite-sample working gate, not a calibrated statistical test; no U may be hidden by diagnostic tie scores
